citations.assessment: Rav Eina adduces Isaiah’s water-drawing verse in this discussion.
The objection is explicitly attributed to Rav Eina in the discussion of Jubilee and New Year.
Rav Yehudah and Rav Eina differ on the reading of the same term. Mar Zutra explains both without assigning the readings to individual disputants.
The named preacher is Rav Eina, with no elder qualification. Rabbah rebukes his ruling on covering blood after slaughter for a sick person on Shabbat.
The exact Arukh entry gives both interpretations, including silencing the interpreter as the second. Its embedded folio is printed 74, whereas the directly matched Bavli passage is 84b.
